title: Yupek Yoly
description:
An identity for an education centre bringing Chinese-language studies to Turkmenistan.

Yupek Yoly takes its name from the Silk Road, the route that once connected Central Asia and China. The identity picks up that idea of connection: a clear, confident system that feels at home in both cultures.

The work covers the logo, typography, colour and the everyday pieces students actually see, from course materials to signage in the centre.
